description: This walk takes you from the East Devon village of Colyton to Seaton via Colyford. The route runs for about 3.6 miles, following public footpaths and quiet roads between the two settlements. Starting in Colyford you head south along the River Coly to neighbouring Colyford. The next section takes you through Seaton Marshes nature reserve where you can look out for a variety of interesting flora and fauna. The Tramway Walk will take you towards the sea front in Seaton where the walk finishes with some splendid coastal views. You can also make the journey between the two settlements by electric tram.
